title: Materialize FA3-safe Buzz runtime admission wrapper without promoting raw buzz-dev-mcp
decisions: Buzz remains optional, disabled by default, non-authoritative and non-blocking for global promotion while disabled.
Raw buzz-dev-mcp is NON_CONFORMING_DIRECT_HOST_TOOL_PROVIDER and MUST be denied as a direct FA3 tool provider.
A Buzz runtime may be admitted only behind the existing Central MCP/Capability Gateway with explicit workspace containment and capability narrowing.
Provider discovery MUST NOT execute candidates; path, staged identity and digest MUST be revalidated before any use.
Protocol/version negotiation MUST complete before any secret handle or delegated capability crosses the provider boundary.
Raw Buzz private-key/nsec transfer is forbidden by default; use leased scoped secret handles under the existing FA3 secrets boundary.
Owner attestation is provenance/delegation evidence only and cannot substitute for an FA3 authorization lease.
Mutation order is read current state, proposed diff, authorization/human gate, apply, post-state verification.
Host-resolved paths MUST NOT cross remote substrate boundaries; target paths are re-derived in the target scope.
Current-host runtime promotion requires a real E2E receipt and cannot be fabricated by CI reference fixtures.
